authority: W4B-SC-v1.0 rules plus this recall amendment govern the authoritative Kalshi semantic materialization v1.1. v1 output, if later completed, is diagnostic/non-authoritative.

only_change.from: retrieve only raw series with a boundary hit in series_title/category
only_change.to: retrieve all 488 W4-A raw candidate series and apply the exact same frozen event-level strict rules to every event

rationale: Completeness audit identified a recall risk before reading any v1 semantic output: restricting retrieval to boundary hits in series_title/category can miss a true event discovered through tags whose market text would satisfy the frozen strict family rule. W4 maximizes defensible N, so all 488 W4-A raw candidate series must receive the same strict event-level evaluation.
